name: Ghe hap
summary: Swimming crab picked from a night-market stall and steamed. It is a different crab from cua mặt trăng.
howToEat: Choose the crab and have it steamed. The market opens at 17:00.
where: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng, in the open yard in front of the daily market.
seoTitle: Ghe hap — steamed swimming crab in Con Dao
seoDescription: Ghẹ hấp is swimming crab steamed to order at the Côn Đảo night market.
